easy.def: Sad because you are by yourself.
examples: The new kid felt lonely at lunch.
The lonely dog wanted a friend.
I feel lonely when you are away.

more.def: Feeling sad because you are alone or have no one to talk to.
examples: He felt lonely after his best friend moved away.
The lighthouse stood on a lonely stretch of coast.
She was lonely at first, but soon made new friends.

easy.def: Not short from one end to the other.
examples: The snake is long.
She has long hair.
It is a long road.

more.def: Measuring a great distance from one end to the other, or lasting for a great amount of time.
examples: The giraffe has a very long neck.
It was a long walk to the top of the hill.
We waited for a long time at the station.

easy.def: To use your eyes to see something.
examples: Look at the bird.
She looked out the window.
I am looking for my shoe.

more.def: To turn your eyes toward something, or to search for it.
examples: Look both ways before you cross the street.
The detective looked carefully for clues under the table.
We looked everywhere for our lost kitten.
You look happy.
The cake looks good.
It looks like rain.

more.def: To appear to be a certain way when someone sees you.
examples: The old house looks scary at night.
You look tired, so maybe you should rest.
Those clouds look like they will bring a storm.
I have a lot of toys.
She ate a lot.
There are lots of stars.

more.def: A large number or amount of something.
examples: There were a lot of people at the parade.
We learned a lot about space on our trip to the museum.
He eats lots of vegetables.

easy.def: To care very much about someone.
examples: I love my mom.
She loves her dog.
We love you.

more.def: To care deeply for someone, or to enjoy something very much.
examples: I love my grandparents, and I visit them every week.
He loves to read about space.
We loved the story so much that we read it twice.

easy.def: A very strong, warm feeling for someone.
examples: She sent her love.
He has love for his dog.
Mom shows her love with a hug.

more.def: A deep feeling of caring for another person or thing.
examples: A mother bear shows her love by keeping her cubs safe.
The class showed their love for the teacher with a card.
He has a love of music.
My dog is loyal to me.
A loyal friend is always there for you.
The loyal knight helped the king.

more.def: Always faithful and true to a person, group, or idea.
examples: A loyal friend stands by you even when things are hard.
The team has loyal fans who come to every game.
He stayed loyal to his friends when others teased them.
